t: You're looking at St Peter's Church in Walworth, an Anglican parish church built between 1823 and 1825. It was the first church designed by Sir John Soane, and it was part of the wave of church building that followed the Napoleonic Wars. It is the best preserved of his churches. Soane was a Neo-Classical architect, the son of a bricklayer, who rose to the top of his profession. He became professor of architecture at the Royal Academy and was knighted in 1831.
